title: Refactor list and header views to render structured sections directly
description: Replace view-layer parsing/grouping helpers with direct rendering from `ShoppingListDocument`, including separate notes and meals sections, aisle ordering from the document, and summary counts from flattened aisle items.
acceptance_criteria: `ShoppingListDetailView` renders notes and meals as separate collapsible sections above aisle groups and iterates `document.aisles` directly in file order.
`ShoppingListHeaderView` reads structured notes and meals content rather than extracted markdown header text.
`ShoppingListsView` derives item and done counts from structured aisle entries rather than `ShoppingList.items`.
